extraction.notes: Official Gazette text of the Civil Servants Act, NN 155/2023, in Croatian. Text-file page numbers are PDF page numbers. Only claims on access to employment for EU workers in Croatia were extracted (RI-FMW-001, LIM-0026). Pass 1 does not assign issues. The law says nothing on how many EU nationals applied or were appointed. Each quote is machine translated. Quotes keep the stray spaces of the converted text.

items.stated_text: Državni službenici su osobe koje u državnim tijelima kao redovito zanimanje obavljaju poslove iz djelokruga tih tijela utvrđene Ustavom Republike Hrvatske (u daljnjem tekstu: Ustav), zakonom ili drugim propisima donesenim na temelju Ustava i zakona.
items.translation_en: Civil servants are persons who in state bodies, as their regular occupation, perform the duties within the remit of those bodies determined by the Constitution of the Republic of Croatia (hereinafter: the Constitution), by law or by other regulations adopted on the basis of the Constitution and law.
items.summary: Civil servants are persons regularly carrying out the duties of state bodies as set by the Constitution, law or other regulations.

items.stated_text: Državni službenici su i osobe koje u državnim tijelima obavljaju informatičke poslove, opće i administrativne poslove, planske, materijalno-financijske i računovodstvene poslove i slične poslove.
items.translation_en: Civil servants are also persons who in state bodies perform IT duties, general and administrative duties, planning, material-financial and accounting duties and similar duties.
items.summary: Civil servants also include persons in state bodies doing IT, general and administrative, planning, financial, accounting and similar work.

items.stated_text: d) imati hrvatsko državljanstvo, ako ovim zakonom nije drukčije propisano.
items.translation_en: d) have Croatian citizenship, unless otherwise provided by this Act.
items.summary: A person admitted to the civil service must have Croatian citizenship, unless this Act provides otherwise.

items.stated_text: U državnu službu može se primiti državljanin države članice Europskog gospodarskog prostora ili Švicarske Konfederacije koji zna hrvatski jezik i latinično pismo.
items.translation_en: A national of a Member State of the European Economic Area or of the Swiss Confederation who knows the Croatian language and the Latin script may be admitted to the civil service.
items.summary: A national of an EEA Member State or Switzerland who knows Croatian and the Latin script may be admitted to the civil service.

items.stated_text: Državljanin države članice Europskoga gospodarskog prostora ili Švicarske Konfederacije i državljanin treće zemlje ne mogu se primiti u državnu službu na poslove iz članka 4. stavka 2. ovoga Zakona.
items.translation_en: A national of a Member State of the European Economic Area or of the Swiss Confederation and a third-country national may not be admitted to the civil service for the duties referred to in Article 4 paragraph 2 of this Act.
items.summary: EEA, Swiss and third-country nationals may not be admitted to the civil service for the duties in Article 4(2).

items.stated_text: Ovaj Zakon objavit će se u »Narodnim novinama«, a stupa na snagu 1. siječnja 2024., osim članaka 60. i 61. koji stupaju na snagu 1. lipnja 2024., članaka 66. – 73. koji stupaju na snagu 1. srpnja 2024. i članaka 62. – 65. koji stupaju na snagu 1. siječnja 2026.
items.translation_en: This Act shall be published in the Official Gazette and shall enter into force on 1 January 2024, except for Articles 60 and 61, which enter into force on 1 June 2024, Articles 66 to 73, which enter into force on 1 July 2024, and Articles 62 to 65, which enter into force on 1 January 2026.
items.summary: The Act enters into force on 1 January 2024, except certain articles on later dates; Article 52 is not among the exceptions.
